description: Source code for the Bluetooth GATT Device Information Service (DIS) implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including characteristics for device info such as model, manufacturer, serial number, firmware, hardware, and software revisions, with support for PNP ID and settings storage.

methods.name: read_str
methods.description: Reads string characteristics for device info fields.

methods.name: read_pnp_id
methods.description: Reads the PNP ID characteristic if enabled.

methods.name: dis_set
methods.description: Handles loading device info settings from storage.
